home.aboutTitle: Everything your community needs, in one bot.
home.aboutDescription: Alren helps members discover commands, verify their accounts, and share osu! maps without leaving Discord.

guide.title: Set up Alren, step by step.
guide.description: A practical guide for members and server administrators—from adding the bot to verification, beatmaps, and community alerts.

sections.title: Add Alren and open the guide
sections.description: Add Alren to your Discord server, then open the private command menu. Slash commands may take a few minutes to appear after the bot joins.
sections.note: The help menu is private, so only you can see it.

sections.title: Chat privately with Alren
sections.description: Use the slash command for a private reply. Prefix-command replies are sent by DM. Clear the current conversation whenever you want a fresh start.
sections.note: Slash replies delete automatically after five minutes.

sections.title: Verify an osu! account
sections.description: Members receive a private OAuth button, sign in to osu!, and Alren detects their account automatically. Administrators should configure the verified role first.
sections.note: The Alren role must be above the verified role in Server Settings → Roles.

sections.title: Post a random beatmap
sections.description: Post an osu! beatmap with cover artwork. Optionally choose Ranked, Qualified, Loved, or all statuses and select a game mode.
sections.note: Without options, Alren uses the filters saved for the server.

sections.title: Enable the automatic beatmap feed
sections.description: Run the settings command in the channel that should receive new beatmaps. Alren saves the channel and default filters for the server.
sections.note: The first setup records the latest map without reposting an old one. Later checks run automatically.

sections.title: Configure community alerts
sections.description: Choose a channel for BN request openings and Mappers' Guild missions, then select one osu! mode or all modes.
sections.note: Alren only posts new changes after setup; it does not replay existing alerts.

sections.title: Use the all-in-one setup panel
sections.description: Administrators can review or configure the verification role, beatmap feed, and community alerts from one private command.
sections.note: You can provide only the options you want to change; existing settings stay in place.

guide.permissionsDescription: Place the Alren role high enough in the role list and allow these permissions in every configured channel.

troubleshooting.title: Slash commands are missing
troubleshooting.description: Wait a few minutes, then reload Discord with Ctrl+R. Confirm the bot was invited with the applications.commands scope.

troubleshooting.title: Verification role is not awarded
troubleshooting.description: Move the Alren role above the verified role and confirm that Alren has Manage Roles permission.

troubleshooting.title: No feed or alert messages appear
troubleshooting.description: Run the related settings command again, verify the selected channel, and allow View Channel and Send Messages.
